name: Professional Kinesiology

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum 2.50 CGPA calculated on courses counting toward the certificate is required for graduation.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The following documentation must be provided to and approved by the BPK department advisor prior to applying for graduation.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in kinesiology (or completion of requirements for graduation) A current cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) certificate A current First Aid Certificate Student membership in the BC Association of Kinesiologists Successful granting of at least one of the following external personal training certifications Canadian Fitness Education Services - Personal Training Canadian Society for Exercise Physiology - Certified Personal Trainer National Strength and Conditioning Association (NSCA) - Certified Personal Trainer Completion of eight months of co-operative education in a related area approved by the BPK co-operative education coordinator, or equivalent.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Please note that credits applied to the professional kinesiology certificate may not be applied to the occupational ergonomics certificate or any other certificate offered at Simon Fraser University.

sections.note:
+courses have additional prerequisites
Students are required to apply to the BPK advisor to have outside employment evaluated as the equivalent for this requirement.
For those who wish to complete both the professional kinesiology certificate AND the occupational ergonomics certificate, it is best to consult the BPK advisor for assistance in course planning.
